title: The Signal That Was Not Yet a Discovery
title_ja: まだ発見とはいえなかった信号

source_links.title: NASA: Reconnaissance of Potentially Habitable Worlds

fact_notes: 授業内の惑星と観測データは架空のシミュレーションであり、生命発見に関する実在の発表ではありません。
一般的な分光観測・モデル比較・偽陽性への注意はNASA・ESAの公開解説に基づきます。

sentences.en: A university astronomy club receives a fictional set of telescope observations for a classroom project about a distant planet orbiting another star.
sentences.ja: 大学の天文クラブは別の恒星を回る遠い惑星に関する授業活動のため架空の望遠鏡観測データを受け取ります。

sentences.en: The dataset includes changes in starlight recorded as the imagined planet passes in front of its host star from the observer's perspective.
sentences.ja: データには架空の惑星が観測者から見て主星の前を通過するときの星の光の変化が含まれます。

sentences.en: A graph shows a small pattern that some students interpret as possible evidence of a particular gas in the planet's atmosphere.
sentences.ja: グラフには一部の生徒が惑星大気中の特定の気体の可能な証拠と解釈する小さな傾向が示されています。

sentences.en: One enthusiastic member suggests announcing that the class has found a world where living organisms may exist.
sentences.ja: 熱心な部員は生物が存在するかもしれない世界を見つけたと発表することを提案します。

sentences.en: However, their instructor points out that the observations are simulated and that even genuine atmospheric signals require careful interpretation.
sentences.ja: しかし指導者は観測が模擬であり本物の大気信号でさえ慎重な解釈が必要だと指摘します。

sentences.en: The students must distinguish what the graph depicts from what it would actually justify scientists claiming about a real planet.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちはグラフが描くことと実際の惑星について科学者が主張する正当な範囲を区別する必要があります。

sentences.en: They begin by listing several possible explanations for the pattern instead of treating their most exciting interpretation as a discovery.
sentences.ja: 最も刺激的な解釈を発見とみなす代わりに傾向の複数の説明を並べることから始めます。

sentences.en: The exercise becomes an investigation into the difference between a promising clue, a supported conclusion, and an extraordinary claim.
sentences.ja: 活動は有望な手がかり、裏づけられた結論、並外れた主張の違いを調べるものとなります。

sentences.en: When a planet passes between its star and an observer, a small fraction of the starlight may pass through the planet's atmosphere.
sentences.ja: 惑星が恒星と観測者の間を通ると星の光のごく一部が惑星の大気を通過する場合があります。

sentences.en: Certain gases can affect the light at particular wavelengths, leaving patterns that astronomers may investigate with instruments and models.
sentences.ja: 特定の気体はある波長の光に影響し、天文学者が機器とモデルで調べる傾向を残すことがあります。

sentences.en: For example, scientists may compare observations taken at different wavelengths to explore whether an atmospheric model explains the recorded signal.
sentences.ja: 例えば科学者は異なる波長での観測を比べ、大気モデルが記録された信号を説明するか調べることがあります。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a signal that resembles a familiar atmospheric feature is not automatically proof that the corresponding molecule is present.
sentences.ja: それでもよく知られた大気の特徴に似た信号が対応する分子の存在の自動的な証明になるわけではありません。

sentences.en: Stellar activity, instrument limitations, background noise, and assumptions in the model can all complicate the interpretation of faint data.
sentences.ja: 恒星の活動、機器の限界、背景の雑音、モデルの仮定は弱いデータの解釈を複雑にします。

sentences.en: The astronomy club therefore discusses the difference between detecting a pattern and identifying its cause with sufficient confidence.
sentences.ja: そのため天文クラブは傾向を検出することと原因を十分な確信をもって特定することの違いを話し合います。

sentences.en: They also learn that a planet's position within a region sometimes described as a habitable zone does not establish that life is present.
sentences.ja: 居住可能領域と呼ばれることがある区域に惑星があることは生命の存在を確定しないとも学びます。

sentences.en: The possibility of conditions suitable for life is a question to study, not an answer guaranteed by the planet's orbital location.
sentences.ja: 生命に適した条件の可能性は調べるべき問いであり軌道上の位置によって保証された答えではありません。

sentences.en: The instructor divides students into groups and gives each group a different atmospheric model to compare with the same simulated measurements.
sentences.ja: 指導者は生徒を班に分け、同じ模擬測定値と比較する異なる大気モデルを各班に渡します。

sentences.en: One model includes a gas that attracts public attention because certain biological processes on Earth can produce it.
sentences.ja: 一つのモデルには地球上の特定の生物学的過程が作り得るため注目される気体が含まれます。

sentences.en: Another model represents a different combination of substances and environmental processes that could produce a similar observational pattern.
sentences.ja: 別のモデルは似た観測上の傾向を生むかもしれない異なる物質と環境過程の組合せを表します。

sentences.en: Instead of asking which model has the most interesting story, students examine how well each explanation fits the data and what remains uncertain.
sentences.ja: どのモデルが最も面白い話を持つか尋ねず、各説明がデータにどの程度合い何が不明か調べます。

sentences.en: The groups discover that two models may account for some of the same features even when their implied planetary environments differ substantially.
sentences.ja: 示唆する惑星環境がかなり違っても二つのモデルが一部の同じ特徴を説明できると班は気づきます。

sentences.en: They therefore avoid claiming that a familiar molecule must have been detected simply because one model provides an attractive match.
sentences.ja: 一つのモデルが魅力的に一致するだけで既知の分子が必ず検出されたと主張することを避けます。

sentences.en: The instructor encourages them to identify what further observations might help distinguish the models rather than choosing a winner prematurely.
sentences.ja: 指導者は早まって勝者を決める代わりにモデルを見分ける助けとなる追加観測を特定するよう促します。

sentences.en: The exercise illustrates why an explanation that fits available evidence can still be provisional and open to revision.
sentences.ja: この活動は利用可能な証拠に合う説明でも暫定的で修正の余地がある理由を示します。

sentences.en: The class then considers how a scientific result should be communicated to readers who have not studied the measurement techniques.
sentences.ja: クラスは測定技術を学んでいない読者へ科学的結果をどう伝えるべきか考えます。

sentences.en: An exciting headline might describe the imagined signal as evidence of life, while a careful report would explain the competing explanations.
sentences.ja: 刺激的な見出しは架空の信号を生命の証拠と表現するかもしれませんが、慎重な報告は競合する説明を述べます。

sentences.en: Yet the students recognize that communicating only limitations can make it difficult for the public to understand why the investigation matters.
sentences.ja: しかし限界だけを伝えると調査の重要性が一般の人々に伝わりにくいとも認識します。

sentences.en: They try writing a summary that states the observed pattern, explains the uncertainty, and describes useful questions for future research.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは観測された傾向を示し、不確かさを説明し、将来の研究に役立つ問いを述べる要約を書いてみます。

sentences.en: The summary clearly identifies the dataset as fictional and avoids suggesting that their classroom exercise represents a real scientific detection.
sentences.ja: 要約はデータが架空であることを明示し、教室の活動が実際の科学的発見であると示唆することを避けます。

sentences.en: Students discuss how responsible communication can preserve curiosity without replacing uncertainty with a stronger claim than the evidence supports.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは証拠以上の強い主張で不確かさを置き換えずに好奇心を保つ責任ある伝え方を話し合います。

sentences.en: They also distinguish the discovery of a gas from the much greater claim that living organisms produced it on a distant planet.
sentences.ja: 気体の発見と遠い惑星で生物がそれを作ったというはるかに大きな主張も区別します。

sentences.en: This distinction helps them see that the search for life depends on interpreting several lines of evidence within a broader planetary context.
sentences.ja: この違いにより生命探査がより広い惑星の文脈で複数の証拠を解釈することに依存すると理解します。

sentences.en: At the final presentation, the astronomy club shows its simulated observations alongside several alternative explanations for the same spectral feature.
sentences.ja: 最終発表で天文クラブは模擬観測と同じスペクトルの特徴に対する複数の代替説明を一緒に示します。

sentences.en: They explain what the data appear to suggest, what they do not establish, and which observations would help reduce uncertainty.
sentences.ja: データが何を示唆し何を確定せず、どんな観測が不確かさを減らすか説明します。

sentences.en: As a result, audience members ask questions about the differences between detection, interpretation, and confirmation rather than demanding an immediate announcement of life.
sentences.ja: その結果聞き手は生命の即時の発表を求めるのでなく検出、解釈、確認の違いについて質問します。

sentences.en: The students acknowledge that scientific caution does not mean abandoning ambitious questions about worlds beyond our solar system.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは科学的な慎重さが太陽系外の世界についての大きな問いを放棄することではないと認めます。

sentences.en: Instead, careful standards make bold questions more meaningful by showing which conclusions can genuinely be supported at each stage.
sentences.ja: むしろ慎重な基準は各段階で本当に支えられる結論を示すことで大胆な問いをより意味あるものにします。

sentences.en: The club also recognizes that further observations may revise an appealing interpretation, and that such revision is part of progress rather than an embarrassment.
sentences.ja: クラブは追加観測が魅力的な解釈を修正する場合があり、その修正は恥ではなく進歩の一部だとも認識します。

sentences.en: Their fictional investigation ends without a dramatic discovery, but with a clearer understanding of how evidence from distant places must be evaluated.
sentences.ja: 架空の調査は劇的な発見なしに終わりますが、遠い場所からの証拠をどう評価すべきかより明確に理解します。

sentences.en: A responsible search for life elsewhere begins not with certainty about what we hope to find, but with careful attention to what the universe allows us to know.
sentences.ja: ほかの場所で生命を探す責任ある探究は見つけたいものへの確信ではなく、宇宙が私たちに何を知ることを許すかへの注意から始まります。

questions.prompt: What important warning does the instructor give?
options: The students have already discovered life.
All simulated graphs are identical to real measurements.
A gas signal always proves an inhabited planet.
The observations are simulated and genuine signals require careful interpretation.
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落「しかし指導者は観測が模擬であり本物の大気信号でさえ慎重な解釈が必要だと指摘します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What distinction does the exercise investigate?
options: The size of planets and classrooms.
Fictional and real student identities.
Clues, supported conclusions, and extraordinary claims.
Different types of school timetables.
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落「活動は有望な手がかり、裏づけられた結論、並外れた主張の違いを調べるものとなります。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: How can researchers investigate an exoplanet atmosphere?
options: By using a drawing as an exact measurement.
By comparing patterns at different wavelengths with atmospheric models.
By visiting the exoplanet directly with students.
By reading only the planet's name.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落「例えば科学者は異なる波長での観測を比べ、大気モデルが記録された信号を説明するか調べることがあります。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What does location in a habitable zone fail to prove?
options: That life is present on the planet.
That the planet moves around a star.
That it has an orbital location.
That people can ask questions about it.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落「居住可能領域と呼ばれることがある区域に惑星があることは生命の存在を確定しないとも学びます。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: How do students compare atmospheric models?
options: By choosing the most exciting story.
By comparing only the model names.
By declaring every model equally confirmed.
By evaluating fit, uncertainty, and possible alternatives.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落「どのモデルが最も面白い話を持つか尋ねず、各説明がデータにどの程度合い何が不明か調べます。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What further step does the instructor encourage?
options: Avoiding additional data.
Publishing the fictional dataset as an actual discovery.
Identifying new observations that could distinguish the models.
Selecting the first model immediately.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落「指導者は早まって勝者を決める代わりにモデルを見分ける助けとなる追加観測を特定するよう促します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: Why does the class identify the dataset as fictional?
options: To avoid explaining any limitations.
To avoid misleading readers about the classroom simulation.
To make the graph appear more exciting.
To establish that life was detected.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落「要約はデータが架空であることを明示し、教室の活動が実際の科学的発見であると示唆することを避けます。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What is required beyond detecting a particular gas?
options: Evaluating multiple kinds of evidence and planetary context before claiming life.
Assuming that all gases have biological sources.
Treating a single molecule as conclusive.
Ignoring other possible explanations.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落「この違いにより生命探査がより広い惑星の文脈で複数の証拠を解釈することに依存すると理解します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: How do audience members change their questions?
options: They demand that the class declare life immediately.
They stop asking about evidence.
They focus only on the presentation's colors.
They ask about detection, interpretation, and confirmation.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落「その結果聞き手は生命の即時の発表を求めるのでなく検出、解釈、確認の違いについて質問します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What is the passage's central argument?
options: Scientific caution prevents all ambitious research.
A model that fits a signal should never be revised.
Careful interpretation of limited evidence makes the search for life more responsible and meaningful.
An intriguing atmospheric pattern directly proves life.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落「ほかの場所で生命を探す責任ある探究は見つけたいものへの確信ではなく、宇宙が私たちに何を知ることを許すかへの注意から始まります。」が正答の根拠です。

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 複数の証拠を併せて解釈します。
